page.overview:
What is Combined Kingdoms?

The Combined Kingdoms (full name: the Combined Kingdoms of Argive, Korlis, and Yotia) were the result of the unity of the two kingdoms Argive and Korlis that formed in 36 AR, as part of the Coronation in the Combined Kingdoms, with the later addition of Yotia.

The prince of Argive married the granddaughter of the lord of Korlis, and the old king of Argive abdicated, putting the rule of both kingdoms under the new royal couple, while Urza was crowned as Lord Protector of the Realm.

After the Liberation of Yotia, Yotia was included in the Combined Kingdoms as a vassal state, though Yotia's Queen, Kayla bin-Kroog, remained in Penregon.
